content: Kamal 2 moved secrets from .env to .kamal/secrets; Kamal does not auto-load .env. Storing plaintext secrets directly in .kamal/secrets checked into git is the critical anti-pattern. Secrets must be explicitly listed per role/accessory to be exposed to that container. Use 1Password/Bitwarden/doppler adapters or pull from environment/CI secrets via command substitution instead of plaintext.
